verdict.rationale: Statsig documents a Console API described as a CRUD API for performing console actions without the web UI. That plausibly covers dashboards and saved Metrics Explorer analyses, but the evidence never names dashboards or saved insights as API resources. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of dashboard and saved-insight create/update/delete endpoints, a published API schema (OpenAPI probes returned 404), and hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can create and manage dashboards and saved insights programmatically via the API

citations.quote: The Console API is the CRUD API for performing the actions available on console.statsig.com without using the web UI.
Metrics Explorer is where you analyze your product data to understand how users interact with your product
